gloss: tens of times; dozens of times as much

definitions.gloss: tens of times; dozens of times as much
definitions.explanation: a multiplier roughly in the range of ten to ninety-nine times, used to express a large but imprecise difference in scale

examples.japanese: {処理|しょり}{速度|そくど}が{数十倍|すうじゅうばい}になった。
examples.english: The processing speed increased by dozens of times.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}の{地価|ちか}は{郊外|こうがい}の{数十倍|すうじゅうばい}だ。
examples.english: Land prices in the city center are dozens of times higher than in the suburbs.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{普及|ふきゅう}により、{情報|じょうほう}の{伝達|でんたつ}{速度|そくど}は{以前|いぜん}の{数十倍|すうじゅうばい}に{達|たっ}している。
examples.english: With the spread of the internet, the speed of information transmission has reached dozens of times what it was before.

notes:
Composed of {数|すう} (several) + {十|じゅう} (ten) + {倍|ばい} (times/fold). Part of a productive pattern: {数|すう} + counter creates approximate numbers ({数十|すうじゅう} = tens of, {数百|すうひゃく} = hundreds of, {数千|すうせん} = thousands of). Adding {倍|ばい} expresses multiples. Commonly used in news, technology, and business contexts to describe dramatic increases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数十倍|すうじゅうばい}になる: to become dozens of times greater
- {数十倍|すうじゅうばい}の{差|さ}: a difference of dozens of times
- {数十倍|すうじゅうばい}に{増|ふ}える: to increase by dozens of times

RELATED WORDS:
- {数倍|すうばい}: several times — a smaller multiplier
- {数百倍|すうひゃくばい}: hundreds of times — a larger multiplier
- {何倍|なんばい}: how many times — question form
